CHAPTER VI

OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY

Of offences affecting life

Punishment for murder. (Change)

103. (1) Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death.

(2) When a group of five or more persons commits murder. (Section 103(2) of BNS shall not come into force on 1st July 2024)

104.  Whoever, being under sentence of imprisonment for life, commits murder.

Illustration

(a) A, a life-convict, kills Z.
